notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, or the land card in your hand must be a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {G}.
easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to Blinkmoth Nexus.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Blinkmoth Nexus.
When the Blinkmoth Nexus token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Blinkmoth Nexus token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 6.
